audit.whatIsWrong: The published chart gave Heimerdinger five of seven stages at 2/10 — Level 3, Level 6 and 2+ items included — against a 50.61% Gangplank win rate. It also disagrees with the packet chart AND with this page's own prose in four rows.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gangplank / Skill. The prose agrees with the packet, not the page: whys[2] says level 3 'evens out ... neither side kills here'; whys[4] says the level-6 all-in 'lands about even'; whys[5] calls first item 'your clearest favour window'; whys[6] says 'he scales as hard as you'. Three separate sources against the chart.
audit.corrected: Levels 3, 6 and 2+ items moved from Heimerdinger 2/10 to Skill 5/10, and First item from Skill 5/10 to Gangplank 6/10, in both layers. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was described only as 'his E stun into rockets'; UPGRADE!!! — the thing that actually changes at 6 — was never mentioned, in either layer.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70 and empowers his NEXT spell rather than being a standalone threat. That is why level 6 is dangerous: it is an upgraded grenade, not a new ability, and it is the cast you must not eat.
audit.corrected: mid now names UPGRADE!!! (R), its 100s cooldown, and the next-spell mechanic, and ties Remove Scurvy to the upgraded stun specifically.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line says it: this matchup never names a single one of Heimerdinger's abilities. The content layer says 'Q turret', 'W rockets', 'E stun grenade' throughout, and the full layer invents the short form 'CH-2 Grenade'. The grenade's actual behaviour was also unstated — it stuns only on a direct hit and merely slows everything around it.
audit.why: Direct-hit-only is the entire skill expression of this lane: an edge clip costs you a slow, a centre hit costs you the trade. A player who thinks the whole area stuns will play far further back than they need to.
audit.corrected: H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q), Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) with their 1325 range against your 625, and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) on a flat 11s with the direct-hit-stun rule, written into whys[0], spikes[0], early, mid, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1].

edits.after: H-28 G turrets and Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) reach 1325 to your 625 and zone you off every minion, and he free-hits your keg — last-hit at max Parrrley range.

edits.before: His Q turret garrison walls you off the minions and his W rockets chip you every time you walk up to last-hit — this is his window, so farm with max-range Parrrley (Q) and never melee into the turret line.
edits.after: H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q) walls you off the minions and Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) chip you from 1325 every time you walk up — his window, so farm at max Parrrley range and never melee into the turret line.

edits.before: Heimerdinger owns these levels and you have to respect it. His Q turret garrison and W rockets wall you off the minions, and with no item spike yet your barrels are on long cooldowns and low HP that he can free-hit to deny — never place an E keg inside turret range, the garrison just shoots it before it matters. Last-hit only with max-range Parrrley (Q) so you stay out of the turret-plus-rocket crossfire, and watch for his E: it is a skillshot stun grenade, not point-and-click, so sidestep it and his poke-to-all-in falls apart.
edits.after: Heimerdinger owns these levels and you have to respect it. H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q) and Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) wall you off the minions, and with no item spike your kegs are on long cooldowns and low HP he can free-hit to deny — never place one inside turret range, the garrison shoots it before it matters. Last-hit only at max Parrrley range, and watch CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E): 11s flat, and only a DIRECT hit stuns — clipped by the edge you are merely slowed, so sidestep and his poke-into-all-in falls apart.

edits.before: Once you hit a second E point and your barrels come up faster, this evens out. Drop a Powder Keg right beside his turret line and Parrrley-detonate it — the chained slow zone lets you finally shove him off the freeze and trade through the garrison instead of getting zoned by it. At 6 do not walk into his nest dry: if his E grenade stun lands into a rocket volley, react with Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse the stun and heal the chunk, then Cannon Barrage the turret cluster to break his zone. It is a farm-and-trade-for-tempo phase, not a kill phase.

notes: Two structural problems here. First, the published level chart did not match the packet chart OR this page's own whys in four of seven rows — it handed Heimerdinger levels 3, 6 and 2+ items at 2/10 while the prose called all three even or better. Fixed to the packet chart as one atomic group. Second, the packet's defect line was accurate: not one of Heimerdinger's five abilities was named anywhere on the page, and the full layer had invented the short form 'CH-2 Grenade' for CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. QUESTION FOR THE USER: the full layer still calls this an 8.5/10 difficulty and an 8.5/10 carry threat while the win rate is 50.61% over 330 games and the corrected chart is mostly Skill — do you want diffRating and carryRating pulled down to match, or is 8.5 a deliberate 'this lane is miserable to play even when you win it' rating? I did not touch them.
